import Mathlib
import Nodes.«erdos-1094--h3--h3--h1--h1--h1--h1--h2--h2--h2».Context

open scoped Nat

/-! Hole `h_bs` of a merged partial proof, as a node (D-12 #5, D-29).
Statement generated by the gate from the assembly; immutable (D-3). -/

theorem erdos_1094__h3__h3__h1__h1__h1__h1__h2__h2__h2 : ∀ (h : ℝ → ℝ),
  Continuous h →
    (∃ (M : ℝ) (R : ℝ), ∀ (u : ℝ), |h u| ≤ M * Real.exp u ∧ (R ≤ u → h u = (0 : ℝ))) →
      ∀ (ε : ℝ),
        (0 : ℝ) < ε →
          ∃ (g₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (g₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
            (Continuous g₁ ∧
                (∃ (C : ℝ), ∀ (u : ℝ), |g₁ u| ≤ C / ((1 : ℝ) + u ^ (2 : ℕ))) ∧
                  HasCompactSupport (FourierTransform.fourier fun (u : ℝ) => (↑(g₁ u) : ℂ))) ∧
              (Continuous g₂ ∧
                  (∃ (C : ℝ), ∀ (u : ℝ), |g₂ u| ≤ C / ((1 : ℝ) + u ^ (2 : ℕ))) ∧
                    HasCompactSupport (FourierTransform.fourier fun (u : ℝ) => (↑(g₂ u) : ℂ))) ∧
                (∀ (u : ℝ), g₁ u ≤ h u ∧ h u ≤ g₂ u) ∧
                  ∫ (u : ℝ), g₁ u ≤ ∫ (u : ℝ), h u ∧
                    ∫ (u : ℝ), h u ≤ ∫ (u : ℝ), g₂ u ∧ (∫ (u : ℝ), g₂ u) - ∫ (u : ℝ), g₁ u ≤ ε := by
  sorry
